title: Rabbi Hillel ben Pazi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman describes him as Rabbi Assi’s student, as at the beginning of Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot, chapter 9, where he asks him a question. He is likewise mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Demai, chapter 7, halakhah 7.
He had a son named Rabbi Shimon, who asked him a question, as in Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin, chapter 7, halakhah 5.[^1]

notes.text: The checked Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 9:1 paragraph has Hillel bar Pazi asking Rabbi Yosei, whereas Hyman names Assi and infers a student relation. Demai 7:7 attests Hillel, and Sanhedrin 7:5 explicitly names Shimon son of Hillel asking Hillel. Hyman’s Assi report is retained without changing the Hebrew or admitting a teacher relation from it.
